summary: Resumed Worker 3 and addressed Lead's pre-review concerns on current P1 activity reservation design. Acknowledged Lead notification 8fee583109274cbd928e12ee5e71dca7. Added explicit diagnostic BenchmarkHundredMixedWorkingCalls and ran 100 genuine self calls: 34 SearchText, 33 ReadFiles, 33 NotifyAgent, 44,447ms (444.5ms/call), Git trace2 13,350 process starts/3,199 child starts and 233 canonical commit/push operations (begin/end on each call plus 33 notification writes) on local bare Git fixture. Findings committed to docs/benchmarks/working-activity-lease-2026-11-11.md, demonstrating unacceptable hot-path write amplification versus 159-190ms/read 0 writes in prior 100-GetAssignment leased baseline. Added fail-closed ingress check: if checkout locally has an approved canonical ledger binding but cache cannot resolve agent state/assignment, reject tool rather than silently dispatch without reservation; unbound source-only projects still proceed. Client Release build 0 warnings, explicit benchmark passed, git diff --check clean. Commit 699e17ea pushed on feature/admin-working-ready-correction. Lead notified. Soft 25m limit reached. No review submission, merge, integration or deployment.
